channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em debate, Caiado diz que aumentará autonomia dos governadores na segurança pública
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, a PSD presidential candidate, stated in a debate that he will increase the autonomy of state governors in public security management, prioritizing decisions aligned with each state's specific realities.

item.title: Em entrevista, Lula afirma que vai anunciar o fim da taxa das blusinhas
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced in an interview with TV Record that he will eliminate the 20% tax on international purchases up to $50. The measure aims to reduce consumer costs and boost foreign trade.

item.title: Renan Santos: eleição é jogo de cartas marcadas mandado pelo Master
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, claimed in a debate that the 2026 election is 'a rigged game' with Banco Master as the 'mastermind'. He also suggested that Lula's reelection could lead to the release of banker Daniel Vorcaro, arrested during the petista's third term.

item.title: Lula diz que conversa com Trump já deu frutos e espera que sejam 'bem saborosos'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said his call with Donald Trump has already yielded benefits and hopes the outcomes will be positive. He emphasized the importance of international relations. The statement comes amid the 2026 campaign context.

item.title: Flávio falta a debate e critica Lula: 'Quem está lá não é meu adversário'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro did not attend the Band debate and posted a video on Instagram during the event, criticizing Lula and stating that the attending candidates are not his opponents. He chose not to directly face the other candidates in the debate, reinforcing his position that his main opponent is Lula.

item.title: VÍDEO: Vice de Caiado, Kassab é flagrado dormindo durante debate na Band
item.description: During the presidential debate on TV Bandeirantes, PSD national president and vice-presidential candidate Gilberto Kassab was caught sleeping, including while his running mate Ronaldo Caiado spoke. The debate featured only three candidates, with confirmed absences from Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema.

item.title: Coadjuvantes na disputa levam nomes de Lula e Flávio a debate com insulto, promessa e palestrinha
item.description: The debate organized by Band and Estadão took place without the presence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema, who were the main names in the race. Supporting candidates Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury filled the empty pulpits with criticism, radical promises, and aggressive speeches, using the absence of leaders to gain visibility. Renan launched a campaign rejecting votes from Lula-aligned voters, while Cury positioned himself as a conciliatory figure.

item.title: Lula falta ao debate da Band e aparece na Record
item.description: President Lula (PT) did not participate in the first 2026 presidential debate, held by Band, and had an interview aired by Record at the same time. His absence was criticized during the debate.

item.title: Renan Santos provoca Lula e Flávio ao levar fraldas para debate
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) used diapers with the names of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro to mock both during the Bandeirantes debate, calling them 'cowardly' and 'criminals'. With the absence of top candidates, the debate was left with fewer participants, including Caiado. The broadcast starts at 8 PM.

item.title: Lula diz que se reunirá com Alcolumbre para anunciar fim da "taxa das blusinhas"
item.description: President Lula announced a meeting with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to announce the end of the 'blusinhas tax', an import fee on purchases under $50. The Provisional Measure must pass by September 8th to avoid expiration before October elections.

item.title: Gilberto Kassab é flagrado cochilando em debate da Band
item.description: At the Band's first 2026 presidential debate, Gilberto Kassab, Caiado's running mate, was caught napping in the audience. Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury attended; Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema were absent, with Zema announcing his withdrawal during the event.

item.title: Renan exige que Record questione Lula sobre Lulinha e o INSS
item.description: Renan Santos demanded that Record ask Lula about his son's alleged involvement in the INSS scandal during a Band debate. Lula did not attend the debate and gave an interview to the station instead.

item.title: Em debate esvaziado na “Band”, Renan, Caiado e Cury miram Lula e Flávio
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, held on Band, was marked by criticisms from Renan Santos, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury toward Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro, who did not attend the event. The candidates used the forum to attack their rivals, accusing them of corruption and disrespect for democracy. In addition to the attacks, the attendees also discussed proposals on security, education, and public policies.

item.title: Fora de debate, Flávio diz que adversário é Lula: “Com ele que quero debater”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, absent from the first 2026 presidential debate, used social media to state that his opponent is President Lula, criticizing the economy and cost of living under the current government. He proposed cuts to bureaucracy, taxes and public spending, alongside stricter security laws and anti-corruption measures.

item.title: Sem Lula e Flávio, debate vira jogral e beneficia Renan Santos na ‘lacração’
item.description: Without Lula, Flávio, and Zema, the debate turned into a rally of soundbites, benefiting Renan Santos, who used social media language to gain visibility. The event prioritized catchphrases and performance, sidelining programmatic content.

item.title: Caiado usa “Dark Horse” para ironizar Lula: “Dark Lobby”
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado made a pun on the film 'Dark Horse' to criticize Flávio Bolsonaro's record and mock suspicions surrounding lobbying involving businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Fábio Luis Lula. The reference also alludes to former president Lula, suggesting a 'Dark Lobby'.

item.title: Bastidores: debate da Band e do ‘Estadão’ tem ameaça de desistência, protesto e jogo de cena
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Band and Estadão, was marked by threats of withdrawal, external protests, and staged confrontations. Augusto Cury nearly quit in protest of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence but ultimately participated after being convinced by organizers. Romeu Zema also initially withdrew, fearing backlash, while Renan used the free movement rule to stage interactive moments during the broadcast.

item.title: Com Caiado, Renan e Cury, primeiro debate presidencial é marcado por críticas às ausências de Lula e Flávio
item.description: The first 2026 presidential debate, hosted by Band and Estadão, featured Renan Santos (Missão), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Augusto Cury (Avante), while Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema were absent. The candidates’ no-shows were criticized during the debate, which covered security, education and international relations.

item.title: Lula diz que anunciará fim da taxa das blusinhas com Alcolumbre na próxima quarta-feira
item.description: President Lula announced that, next Wednesday, alongside Senate President Davi Alcostre, he will end the so-called 'blusinhas tax,' which charges 20% on international purchases. The provisional measure is already in effect but must be approved by Congress by September 8 to remain valid. The issue has electoral relevance, as reinstating the charge before elections could directly impact voters.

item.title: Cury, Renan e Caiado ultrapassam Flávio no Google
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro missed the presidential debate, allowing Renan Santos, Augusto Cury, and Ronaldo Caiado to surpass his Google search trends. Lula maintained lead in searches, while the absence of Flávio and Zema was criticized by allies as a campaign strategy. The debate aired simultaneously with an exclusive Lula interview on Record.

item.title: Lula diz que não vai interferir em investigações contra Marcola
item.description: President Lula stated he will not interfere in federal police investigations against his former chief of staff, Marcola, and emphasized that anyone who acts improperly must face consequences. The probe investigates potential undue contracts and government access through lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger.

item.title: Renan Santos: ‘Record se entrega ao Lula porque está envolvida no escândalo do Digimais’
item.description: During a live debate on Band, Renan Santos (Missão) criticized Record for broadcasting an exclusive interview with President Lula simultaneously during the debate, accusing the network of political alignment and involvement in the Digimais scandal. Santos personally attacked Lula, calling him a 'drunk bastard' and questioning whether Record would address alleged corruption involving the president's son. Augusto Cury (Avante) also expressed outrage over the simultaneous interview, deeming it disrespectful to democracy.

item.title: Ausente de debate, Lula diz que Lulinha ‘tem de provar inocência’ e detalha telefonema a Trump
item.description: Absent from the Band debate, Lula gave an interview to Record and stated that his son Lulinha must prove his innocence in the investigations into alleged irregularities. He denied political pressure on the federal police and emphasized dialogue with Trump on tariffs and international cooperation.

item.title: Tarifaço: Lula diz que relação com Trump é 'civilizada', mas que segundo escalão do governo dos EUA toma 'atitudes impensáveis'
item.description: President Lula said his relationship with Trump is respectful, but criticized the U.S. second tier, particularly Secretary of State Marco Rubio, for taking inappropriate actions. He advocates for negotiations to reverse tariffs and rejects U.S. allegations as unfounded.

item.title: Qual a idade de Ronaldo Caiado? Quantos anos tem Renan Santos?
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, aged 76, and Renan Santos, aged 42, participated in the first presidential debate of 2026, showing an age gap of 34 years. Additionally, the candidates differ in height: Caiado is 1.90m tall, while Renan Santos measures 1.72m.

item.title: São os eleitores dos candidatos que foram ao debate que irão definir o presidente da República
item.description: In-person debates are being overshadowed by online debates. The voters of the candidates who attended Sunday’s (23rd) debate — Renan Santos (Mission), Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), and Augusto Cury (Avante) — may be decisive in the second round of the 2026 presidential election. The absence of some candidates, such as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, is justified by suspicions of wrongdoing involving their inner circle.

item.title: Trump no centro do debate: Cury prega diálogo e Caiado critica Lula
item.description: In the first open TV presidential debate, hosted by Band, Augusto Cury (Avante) advocated for balanced U.S.-Brazil relations, while Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized remarks by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) toward President Donald Trump, underscoring foreign policy tensions.

item.title: Renan Santos e Augusto Cury divergem sobre a escala 6×1
item.description: Renan Santos criticized the proposal to end the 6×1 workweek, arguing it could harm companies and workers. He advocated for a labor reform allowing hourly contracts, promising people would work less and earn more.

item.title: Qual é a altura de Renan Santos e de Ronaldo Caiado? Diferença de estatura viraliza nas redes
item.description: The height difference between Renan Santos (1.72m) and Ronaldo Caiado (1.90m) became a viral topic after their positioning side-by-side at Band's first presidential debate. The three candidates present criticized the absences of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema.

item.title: Renan Santos afirma que Lula e Flávio deveriam falar no debate sobre 'crimes cometidos'
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão) criticized the absence of Lula and Flávio from debates, stating they should attend to explain the crimes they have committed.

item.title: Em debate, Caiado diz que Lula tem espantado geradores de riqueza do Brasil
item.description: In a recent debate hosted by Band and Estadão, PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized President Lula, claiming his administration has driven away wealth generators from Brazil. Caiado called for a credibility shock in the economy and pledged not to increase the country’s public debt if elected.

item.title: Debate Band/Estadão começa com púlpitos reservados a Lula, Flávio e Zema vazios
item.description: The Band/Estadão debate began with empty pulpits for Lula, Flávio, and Zema, with only Ronaldo Caião, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury participating. The absence of the most popular candidates drew criticism regarding the debate's representativeness. Participants addressed topics such as economy and security.

item.title: Renan chama Lula e seus eleitores de canalhas: 'Não quero seu voto'
item.description: In the first presidential debate on Band, Renan Santos (Missão) called re-election candidate Lula (PT) and his voters 'scoundrels', stating he does not want their votes. The statement sparked strong reactions and highlighted the tense tone of the election.

item.title: Lula diz que não interfere na PF e defende investigação sobre o filho
item.description: President Lula stated in an interview with Record that he does not interfere with the Federal Police and supports investigations into his son, Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, who is under three inquiries. He emphasized that 'no one is above the law' for wrongdoing.

item.title: Augusto Cury é de direita ou de esquerda? Escritor critica polarização em debate presidencial
item.description: Writer Augusto Cury (Avante) criticized political polarization during the presidential debate on TV Bandeirantes, stating Brazil needs national unity. Although he defines himself as having a 'right-wing mind and social heart', he advocates for a central position, focusing on issues like violence against women and AI's impact on the job market.

item.title: “Você será meu xerife”, diz Cury a Caiado, que nega convite
item.description: During a debate on Band, Augusto Cury invited Ronaldo Caiado to be the sheriff of Brazil in his potential government. Caiado declined, stating he intends to run for president.

item.title: “Lula vendeu com a mulher que estocava vento a ideia da Pátria Educadora”
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, criticized the educational policies of Lula and Dilma's governments during a Band debate, mocking the 'Educating Homeland' idea with reference to Dilma's old 'wind farming' statement.

item.title: Cury abre live, declara ausência, volta atrás e participa de debate
item.description: Augusto Cury initially announced his absence from the first presidential debate on Band, citing the absence of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, but later reversed his decision to participate after press pressure. Lula, Flávio, and Zema also skipped the debate to preserve their campaign strategies.

item.title: Cury lamenta “nível de agressividade” de Renan e faz convite a Caiado
item.description: Augusto Cury criticized Renan Santos's aggressive tone during a public security debate on Band, and invited Caiado to broaden the discussion. The Avante candidate highlighted concern over the confrontational climate in the electoral scenario.

item.title: Bastidores: Zema priorizou estreia no Jornal Nacional e não quis virar ‘alvo das pedradas’ em debate
item.description: Romeu Zema chose his debut on Jornal Nacional over attending the first presidential debate, avoiding becoming a target in an unfavorable political showdown. The decision was made behind the scenes due to a tight schedule and the current electoral dynamics.

item.title: Datafolha: 50% acreditam em possível interferência de outros países nas eleições no Brasil
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 50% of voters believe foreign interference in Brazilian elections is possible, while 43% do not believe in this hypothesis.

item.title: Sem Lula, Flávio e Zema, candidatos fazem primeiro debate à Presidência
item.description: The opening presidential debate featured only Augusto Cury (Avante), Renan Santos (Missão) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Flávio Dino and Alexandre de Moraes Zema absent. The three candidates discussed topics such as the economy, public security and healthcare. The absence of the most prominent frontrunners placed greater spotlight on the smaller parties' voices.

item.title: Renan Santos leva fraldas com nomes de Lula e Flávio em debate e critica ausência em debate
item.description: Renan Santos attended the first presidential debate on Band carrying a diaper printed with the names of Lula and Flávio, symbolizing criticism of their absence. The gesture was interpreted as a direct political provocation toward the candidates who did not show up.

item.title: Horário eleitoral começa nesta semana; Globo entrevistará Lula e Flávio
item.description: The electoral campaign intensifies with the start of free TV and radio advertising on Friday. TV Globo will interview President Lula on Thursday and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on Friday.

item.title: Lula e Flávio “não sabem explicar os escândalos”, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's absence from the Band debate, calling them the "most rejected" candidates who cannot explain their scandals. Caiado also previewed that his first economic measure, if elected, would focus on spending control.

item.title: Com Caiado, Renan Santos e Augusto Cury, primeiro debate presidencial tem críticas às ausências de Flávio e Lula
item.description: The first presidential debate was weakened by the absence of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Zema, with only Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury participating. The three candidates criticized the no-shows, highlighting the absentees' reluctance to face accusations and discuss issues like education and public safety.

item.title: Metade dos brasileiros vê risco de interferência estrangeira nas eleições, diz Datafolha
item.description: A new Datafolha survey, filed with the TSE, shows 50% of Brazilians perceive a risk of foreign interference in the 2026 elections. The poll of 2,058 voters was conducted from April 18 to 20, with a maximum margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: No debate da Band, Renan promete estado de defesa contra facções
item.description: In the first televised presidential debate in 2026, promoted by Band, candidate Renan Santos (Missão) stated he plans to declare a state of defense and activate the Law and Order Guarantee in areas dominated by organized crime if elected. The proposal was framed as a measure to combat criminal factions. The debate marked the first TV confrontation between presidential candidates.

item.title: Indecisão de Augusto Cury em debate surpreendeu até equipe do candidato
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) nearly withdrew from the first 2026 presidential debate at Band in protest over the absences of Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema. Lula's interview on Record during the debate slot was the final straw. Cury was already leaving when producers convinced him to participate with 15 minutes remaining. Even his running mate, Julio Delgado, was caught off guard and had to turn back.

item.title: Sem Lula, Flávio e Zema, primeiro debate presidencial de 2026 começa esvaziado
item.description: The first presidential debate of 2026, hosted by TV Bandeirantes, opened with only three candidates present: Ronaldo Caiado, Renan Santos, and Augusto Cury. Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, and Romeu Zema, who are frontrunners in polls, declined to attend, which may shorten the debate.
